label: No infinite actual esse-cause regress, via the weak esse-ground bridge
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation, the weakest-sufficient sibling of esseRegressOfActualGroundingWF, on one m, w and p. If grounding among actual concreta at w is well-founded (82cfaf26), a distinct cause of esse between actual concreta grounds it at w (the new weak bridge), whatever is in act of esse exists at w (546975ef) and whatever has esse in re is concrete in the profile (2d9807a5), then there is no infinite regress of actual causes of being (fd12ad3d). Step: for an actual cause c of x both c and x are in act, so by the two calibrations both are actual concreta, and the weak bridge makes c ground x. It uses the InAct c clause of ActualEsseCause that the sibling discards, and so avoids cb1cdea9's scope condition (a world-free cause of being absent at w). The closed controls weakEsseRegressControls drop each input in a Bool interpretation and give a nonvacuous one. Facts about those interpretations only.

strong_version_needed.82cfaf26-fc86-54ab-8328-9a7b2bdbbe21: The conclusion is full well-foundedness of a relation on the whole carrier, so the premise must exclude every infinite descending grounding chain among actual concreta. The weak versions do not: ConeWellFounded (1b1e3f09) constrains only the ancestor cone of one selected individual, ActualGroundingAsymmetric (39f7c63d) excludes only two-cycles, and closed-collection rootedness (aca3baa1) admits an infinite descending chain whose members also descend from a root (RootedInfiniteControl of ClosedEsseSource).
